content: Just a quick message to convey my thanks to everyone that has contributed to PhysLean during 2025. Whether that be directly contributing to the code-base, messaging on this Zulip, coming along to PhysLean cafes, or giving me private words of advice or encouragement. This project would not have evolved in the same way without each of these contributions, and if there was a way I could further express my gratitude then I would.

I want to give my public thanks to @Alex Zughaid who has been my research intern over the last 8 weeks, and whose last day is today. Alex IMO has done many great things for Physlib over those weeks, I'm going to try list all of those below, though I will no doubt forget some!

  • Made the claim system for reviews
  • Set up a system for references in Physlib and made a webpage for them (https://physlib.io/references)
  • Set up monthly updates (https://physlib.io/monthly-updates/2026-07)
  • Made a webpage for useful prompts (https://physlib.io/prompts)
  • Created a better API tracker (https://physlib.io/api-tracker)
  • Created the label system for size of pull-request.
  • Did a great pass at adding new features the website.
  • Set up the cache for Physlib.
  • Helped populate the Github issues with 'good first issue' contributions.
  • Set up the Physlib Zulip bot

Thank you @Alex Zughaid !!!!

We have such a robust support system around physlib thanks to you, I'm sure the project will grow much more quickly due to your work. Wish you the very best in the future :purple_heart:
